MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Blink doorbell feels like a useful next addition because it adds door monitoring to my Echo setup and complements my existing door alarm.",
    "Alexa-compatible cameras and lighting fit my interest in connected home devices. A larger Echo Show display also has some appeal, even though I am not ready to add one now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The older Echo Dots and Fire TV sticks repeat jobs covered by my recently purchased fourth-generation Dot and Fire TV Stick 4K Max. Sharing familiar features does not give me a reason to replace those devices.",
    "The tablet and iPhone charger do not address a current need. Buying Mac-compatible keyboards does not mean I need an iPhone charger, and using home entertainment devices does not mean I want a portable tablet.",
    "The camera bundle and speaker-and-bulb kit include more equipment than I currently want. I would start with one doorbell or a compatible bulb, while another display with a renewing trial feels premature."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My recent Echo and Fire TV purchases seem to have been taken as reasons to offer more of the same devices, even when I already have newer versions.",
    "My interest in Alexa-compatible additions seems to have been stretched into an interest in whole bundles and other Amazon devices, regardless of whether they add something I need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases matter because they show which needs I have already filled. The Show 5 stand suggests I am still completing that setup, rather than looking for another display immediately.",
    "Accessories that extend equipment I own often make more sense to me than another main device. My remote replacement batteries and recent display stand are examples of keeping an existing setup useful.",
    "Interest in a new function does not mean I want a large commitment: door monitoring appeals to me, but I would try the doorbell before expanding to several cameras."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in an Alexa-connected home, but miss the distinction between useful additions and devices whose roles I have already covered."
}
